# Project Overview

This project is a landing page for StockFlow automatic stock management report generator.

## Folder Structure

- `/app`: Contains the source code for the frontend.
- `/public`: Contains static assets and images.

## Libraries and Frameworks

- Next.js and Tailwind CSS for the frontend.
- Material-UI for UI components.
- Typescript for type safety.

## Coding Standards

- Use semicolons at the end of each statement.

## UI guidelines

- Mobile first approach.
- Application should have a modern and clean design.

## Development
- Use Git for version control.
- Follow best practices for React and Next.js development.
- Use mui-mcp for any changes related to Material-UI components.
